name: What is the typical cost range for senior-friendly bathroom renovations?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for senior-friendly bathroom renovations?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of senior-friendly bathroom renovations varies significantly based on the scope of work and chosen materials. Minor updates, like installing grab bars and a raised toilet, might range from a few hundred to a couple of thousand dollars. More extensive renovations, such as a curbless shower installation, wider doorways, and non-slip flooring, can range from $5,000 to $15,000 or more. Factors like plumbing reconfigurations, electrical work, and tile choices will influence the final price.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for senior-friendly bathroom renovations vary, from a few hundred dollars for minor updates to $5,000-$15,000+ for extensive overhauls like curbless showers.
